title: ArenaPvP
description: ArenaPVP is built for PvP servers — arenas, kits, stats, ranks and economy in one place.
body:
**Paper 26.1.2 · Java 25** All-in-one PvP plugin — arenas, kits, stats, ranked tiers, economy & PlaceholderAPI. --- ## Screenshots


TOP 10 kills — hologram placeholders


TAB — kills, deaths, streak & rank


Arena Kits GUI


Customizable action bar HUD

--- ## Ranked Tiers Based on **total kills**. Customizable in `config.yml` → `ranked.tiers`. | Tier | Kills | Ranks | |------|-------|-------| | Iron | 10 / 25 / 50 | Iron 1–3 | | Gold | 75 / 100 / 150 | Gold 1–3 | | Diamond | 200 / 275 / 350 | Diamond 1–3 | | Netherite | 500 / 650 / 800 | Netherite 1–3 | Use `%arenapvp_rank%` on scoreboards, TAB, holograms & chat. --- ## Placeholders **Stats:** `%arenapvp_kills%` · `%arenapvp_deaths%` · `%arenapvp_kdr%` · `%arenapvp_streak%` · `%arenapvp_best_streak%` · `%arenapvp_rank%` **TOP 10:** `%arenapvp_top_kills__name%` / `_val%` · `%arenapvp_top_deaths__name%` / `_val%` · `%arenapvp_top_streak__name%` / `_val%` --- ## Permissions | Permission | Default | |------------|---------| | `arenapvp.warp` · `arenapvp.kit` · `arenapvp.stats` · `arenapvp.help` · `arenapvp.actionbar` | Everyone | | `arenapvp.setarena` · `arenapvp.kit.create` · `arenapvp.kit.delete` · `arenapvp.stats.others` · `arenapvp.reload` · `arenapvp.update` | OP | | `arenapvp.*` | OP | ---
